env.AGENT_HEADLESS: 1 = no person attached; skills decide instead of asking and report each decision as a `결정 필요:` line
env.AGENT_ASK_CMD: shell command that receives each question under AGENT_HEADLESS=1: <cmd> ask "<question>" --recommend "<option>" [--option "<option>"]...; non-empty stdout is the answer
env.AGENT_SHIP_OWNER: orchestrator = go stops after local commits and a PR body draft (no push, PR, or monitor), and monitor --until-settled commits its fixes locally without pushing or replying; agent or unset = go pushes, opens the PR and reports `pr: <url>`, then monitors it (under AGENT_HEADLESS=1: monitor --until-settled, ending with a `settle:` line), and monitor pushes and replies
env.AGENT_PR_BODY_FILE: where go (and monitor --until-settled, after local fixes) writes the PR draft (line 1 title, line 2 empty, then the body) when AGENT_SHIP_OWNER=orchestrator; default $(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)/gbase/pr-body.md
env.AGENT_EVIDENCE_FILE: JSON Lines file go, reproduce, and monitor --until-settled append check results to: {step, result, command, detail, cause?}; result is pass, fail, skip, or open (review/settle: awaits a decision or a conclusion)

work.notes: The front door for one task (a card, a ticket): picks the route (bug, feature, refactor, …), does the work, and ends in the ship slot's gbase:go — review ∥ polish, verification gate including the repo's verify skill, commits; with AGENT_SHIP_OWNER=agent it also pushes, opens the PR (`pr: <url>`) and settles it (`settle:`), never merging. Under AGENT_HEADLESS=1 even a low-risk change is reviewed before the PR. An orchestrator opens its dev run with this instead of naming review, polish and checks as separate steps; {ticket} is the task's id, and the task itself comes from the orchestrator's prompt.

review.notes: Adversarial review of the uncommitted changes, else the latest commit. Clear, local fixes come back as uncommitted working-tree edits; findings that need a decision come back in a severity table. Never posts to GitHub.

review2.invoke: /gbase:review pre-PR mode; defer, don't ask; report only
review2.notes: The same review run once per model in independent sessions on the same tree; report only, so nothing is edited. The caller merges the two severity tables by file:line and marks each finding opus, sonnet, or both.

polish.notes: Behavior-preserving cleanup of the current diff, applied as uncommitted edits inside the diff only; edits outside the diff and large structural moves are reported, not applied, when headless.

checks.notes: The target repo's fast checks are the lines between <!-- gbase:verify:start --> and <!-- gbase:verify:end --> in CLAUDE.md (or AGENTS.md), one `- <label>: <command in backticks>` line each. Run lint, typecheck, test and `typecheck (no CI)`, preferring the `scoped:` variant; skip CI-only, format, `unverified locally` and `known failing on main` lines. /gbase:setup writes the block after running each command once.

behavior.notes: The target repo's own verify skill drives the real app. Invoke it by its frontmatter name (/verify or /verify-<app>) for the features in its features/ map that the change touches; evidence lands in the directory the skill names. gbase:go already runs it inside its verification gate.

ship.notes: Review and polish in parallel, review fixes, verification gate, then commits. With AGENT_SHIP_OWNER=orchestrator it ends with `ship:` and `PR 본문 초안:` lines and never touches the remote; otherwise it pushes, opens the PR (`pr: <url>`), and monitors it — under AGENT_HEADLESS=1 with monitor --until-settled, ending with a `settle:` line.

settle.notes: Needs gh auth and an open PR for the current branch. Fixes clear CI failures and review comments, then ends once the current head's checks and automated reviewers have concluded, with one `settle: 수렴|미확정|사람 필요 @<sha>` line. With AGENT_SHIP_OWNER=orchestrator its fixes stay local commits, nothing is posted, and after any fix it reports `ship: local …` and `PR 본문 초안:` with a refreshed draft; agent pushes and replies. Never merges, rebases, or force-pushes.

learn.notes: Turns mistakes that recur in the repo's history into enforced checks, each proven to fail on a past instance; /gbase:correct --session runs it as a retrospective on one session. Edits are left uncommitted for the ship slot.

mockup.notes: Builds a clickable single-file HTML mockup of the request from the app's own screens, tokens, fonts and copy, with PNG screenshots per option and step, in $GBASE_MOCKUP_DIR (default ~/design-mockups)/<app>-<YYYYMMDD>-<topic>-r<N>/ — outside the repo, which stays untouched. Explicit only: no other slot or skill (work, ship, …) invokes it, and the model doesn't pick it up on its own. Ends with `mockup:`, `mockup url:` and `mockup shots:` lines. Never asks before the first round; feedback is the next run.

content.notes: One piece of gshorts content (a short, card news, an account name, bio, or caption) under content-common's rules; the request names the format, and that format's skill (shorts-common and its video formats, instagram-card-news) applies with it. Lives in the gshorts plugin: gbase-run loads every plugin of its checkout, an installed setup needs gshorts@godsenal. Outputs land in the work folder the request names; nothing is posted under AGENT_HEADLESS=1.

task.notes: A one-off run with no skill (research, a schedule change): the task is the whole prompt. Use it instead of a bare `claude -p` so the run still gets a stream-json log, result.json, status, and stop.

reproduce.notes: Writes an executable check that fails now (a test, script, HTTP request, or verify-skill journey) and reports its command, the quoted failing output, and the expected result. Never changes product code; an added test or script is left uncommitted.
